newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News Corp UK newspaper Q1 profit up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News Corp UK newspaper Q1 profit up.

text.p: The News Corporation Ltd said on Tuesday that its U.K. newspaper operations enjoyed strong growth with an 18 percent gain in operating profits in the three months to September compared with a year ago.

News Corp said The Sun, The Times and The Sunday Times all posted gains in both advertising and circulation revenues in the first quarter. "Additionally, the group has benefitted from reduced newsprint costs," it said.
News Corp earlier announced a net profit of A$283 million for the three months to September 30, down from A$308 million.
News Corp said average daily U.K. newspaper sales as of September topped 810,000 copies, a 19 percent gain compared to a year ago, which had contributed to a 30 percent rise in advertising revenues.
